title: Frontend: Daily quote sourced from backend with inline fixed time zone setup

requirements.summary: Switch daily quote UI to fetch quote-of-the-day from the backend and prompt users inline to set a fixed UTC offset when not configured.
acceptanceCriteria: The daily quote component renders a quote returned from the backend (not from https://api.quotable.io/random).
If no fixed time zone is configured for the current user, the quote area displays a clear call-to-action to set a time zone (in English) instead of showing an error state.
After the user sets a fixed time zone, the daily quote loads successfully without requiring a full page reload.
User-facing text introduced for this feature is in English.

file_operations.description: Replace external API/localStorage-based quote logic with backend-driven quote loading using the existing actor (via core-infrastructure’s backend connection pattern through useActor). Use React Query (already used in the app) to (1) query the caller’s saved time zone (getCallerTimeZone) and (2) fetch today’s quote (getTodaysQuote) only when a time zone exists. Ensure the hook surfaces a distinct “missing time zone” state separate from generic errors, and expose a refetch function used after saving the time zone. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update rendering to: (1) show an inline time zone setup prompt in the quote area when the hook indicates no configured time zone (do not show “Quote unavailable” in this case), (2) render the backend-provided quote text/author when available, and (3) keep loading/error states user-friendly in English. Wire the new inline prompt component into this view so it is not orphaned. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an inline time zone configuration UI used inside the quote area. Provide a simple fixed UTC offset picker (e.g., select common “UTC±HH:MM” values) and a save action that calls the backend via the actor (setUserTimeZone) and then triggers quote reload without a full page refresh. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Select, Input, Alert) for consistent styling while respecting immutablePaths (compose, don’t modify ui components). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
